headline: Norris is unsure McLaren's Brazil upgrades will make the car easier to drive
body: Norris says McLaren's new front wing, rear wing and floor are there to add performance and may make the MCL40 harder to drive. He calls the car difficult all season and says rivals have developed more than McLaren since the Baku upgrade. McLaren is fourth in the constructors' championship, 17 points behind Red Bull.
